scope: oheco-broker native SDK dependencies (Go and curl have separate manifests)
build_network: forbidden; complete source archives extracted below tpr/

dependencies.name: xquic
dependencies.sdk_policy: SDK checks actual peer QUIC transport parameters through public BoringSSL TLS getter before proof/readiness/OPEN/DATAGRAM; reject nonzero no_crypto. Upstream may internally adopt parameters before SDK gate; no claim of patched-library cipher-policy behavior.
dependencies.build: Unmodified upstream CMake on a cache-owned source snapshot; HTTP/3 retained. Generated source-tree config stays in snapshot, checked-in upstream source remains pristine. SDK dependency probes live under sdk/c/build/probes; full-checkout peer regressions remain under tests/c.

dependencies.name: boringssl
dependencies.license: Apache-2.0; retained support-code notices include Go BSD-3-Clause
dependencies.pake: Upstream BoringSSL SPAKE2, curve25519.h draft-irtf-cfrg-spake2-02 API; Edwards25519/SHA-512, 32-byte messages, 64-byte keys, upstream cofactor/password-scalar compatibility correction. Not asserted RFC 9382 wire-compatible.
dependencies.build: Static ssl/crypto only, PIC, Release, BUILD_TESTING=OFF, OPENSSL_NO_ASM=ON, FIPS=OFF, no symbol prefix

dependencies.name: libjuice
dependencies.license: MPL-2.0; retained source-file third-party notices apply
modifications: include/juice/juice.h: append optional bool relay_only to juice_config_t (default false)

src/agent.c: copy relay_only configuration; centralized local-relayed UDP candidate-pair restriction including peer-reflexive additions and TCP-bypass exclusion, no direct peer connectivity checks or application send/receive in forced mode; host/STUN gathering unchanged
dependencies.remaining_patch_reason: Public selected-pair getter and send are separate operations; a peer may trigger later direct nominations between them. Keep minimal atomic physical local-relay policy rather than weaken FORCE or depend on private ABI. SDK-owned paired tests are sdk/c/build/probes/relay_policy_probe.c.
dependencies.build: Standalone native C ICE/STUN/UDP TURN client, static PIC, no Nettle/WebRTC dependency, NO_SERVER=ON, NO_TESTS=ON, localhost candidates enabled, consent freshness retained

dependencies.name: cjson
dependencies.sdk_policy: All SDK parser calls use shared ob_json_parse_complete mutex; no global error-pointer API, allocator-hook or locale mutation after threads start.
dependencies.build: C11 static PIC, no cJSON_Utils/tests/sanitizers, upstream custom C89/warning flags disabled
